svg.text: MIDYA / PARTSLAB / NONNEGATIVE IS NOT NONAMBIGUOUS
Six manual NMF fits. Original 3,823 fitting / 1,797 held-out UCI digits. No labels in training.
Rank 16 / training-selected seed 23 / each basis display-rescaled separately
Official holdout reconstruction MSE / no clipping in scores
PCA and SVD win at every fixed rank. This is not digit classification.
Every NMF fit exhausts its joint stationarity budget; lower loss is not a global optimum.
Plain multiplicative updates stay at loss 0.5 with a negative blocked gradient.
Coordinate minimization reaches [1,1], loss 0. Same objective, explicit boundary step.
Scaling, permutation and duplicate bases can preserve a sum but change its coefficients.
Alpaydin & Kaynak (1998), UCI Optical Digits. CC BY 4.0 data. MIT code. No endorsement.
